description:
This Java source file defines a step definitions class for testing loan-related COB (Close of Business) processes in a Fineract application using Cucumber. It includes test methods verifying COB processing dates, locked loan accounts, and locking actions.

The class utilizes Spring's dependency injection, interacts with Fineract APIs via Retrofit, and contains multiple step definitions for testing COB behavior in the loan context.

classes.name: LoanCOBStepDef
classes.description: A Cucumber step definitions class for testing COB related scenarios in loan processing within Fineract. Extends AbstractStepDef and uses injected APIs to perform verifications regarding COB dates and loan account locks.

methods.name: checkOldestCOBProcessed
methods.description: Verifies that the oldest COB processed loan's COB date is more than 1 day earlier than the COB business date.

methods.name: listOfLockedLoansEmpty
methods.description: Asserts that there are no currently locked loan accounts in the system.

methods.name: loanIsNotInListOfLockedLoans
methods.description: Checks that a specific loan (created in previous step) is not among the locked loan accounts.

methods.name: placeLockOnLoanAccountWithErrorMessage
methods.description: Places a lock on a loan account with an associated error message, simulating a COB processing lock scenario.

methods.name: placeLockOnLoanAccountNoErrorMessage
methods.description: Places a lock on a loan account without an error message, testing normal lock behavior.
